title: Completed Flow Metrics and Value Stream Dashboard Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Flow Metrics and Value Stream Dashboard artifact data payloads (PMO-06.12).

value_stream_name_and_definition.description: The specific customer value stream, delivery pipeline, or product domain monitored by this flow dashboard.

measurement_window_and_interval.description: The operational reporting period, iteration window, and rolling sample interval evaluated for flow metrics.

wip_limits_and_work_categorization.description: Configured Work in Progress (WIP) caps across workflow stages and item type breakdown (Features, Defect Fixes, Technical Debt, and Risks).

lead_time_and_cycle_time_percentiles.description: 50th, 85th, and 95th percentile delivery times from work commitment to customer deployment, highlighting predictability.

flow_efficiency_and_wait_time_ratio.description: Percentage of total lead time spent in active value-adding touch work versus idle queue/blocking states.

throughput_and_delivery_velocity.description: Completed work items delivered per iteration cycle, indicating steady-state system capacity and throughput stability.

flow_load_and_work_age_health.description: Inventory of active in-flight items, aging WIP items exceeding the 85th percentile threshold, and systemic work overload.

bottleneck_identification_and_root_cause.description: Specific workflow stage where work accumulates as queue inventory and the underlying process constraint.

kaizen_flow_optimization_action.description: Targeted continuous improvement action, WIP constraint adjustment, or dependency unblocking intervention to improve flow.
